name: Attack Moves & Recovery
summary: Warm up the hands, score off a rip-through and a crossover drive, then finish with defensive recovery runs.

drills.name: Wrap-Around Warm-Up
drills.summary: Wake up your hands with wraps, then move into low, quick dribbles.
steps: Wrap the ball around your waist 10 times each way.
Wrap it around each knee 10 times each way.
Do figure wraps around both legs for 30 seconds.
Finish with 30 seconds of hard dribbles at knee height in each hand.

drills.name: Wing Rip-Through Jumpers
drills.summary: Catch on the wing, rip the ball through low, take one hard dribble and rise.
steps: Spin the ball out to yourself on the right wing and catch on two feet.
Rip the ball low and across your knees to the other hip.
Take one hard dribble toward the elbow and pull up.
Do 5 reps, then switch to the left wing.
Keep switching wings until time is up.

drills.name: Crossover Lane Finishes
drills.summary: Cross over at the cone, attack the lane, and finish on the far side of the rim.
steps: Put a cone at the top of the key.
Dribble at the cone and cross over hard right before it.
Attack the lane with a long first step.
Finish with the outside hand on the far side of the rim.

drills.name: Drop-Step Recovery Runs
drills.summary: Defend in stance, open your hips when you get beat, and sprint to recover.
steps: Start in stance at the baseline.
Slide 3 steps, then drop-step like you got beat.
Turn and sprint to the free throw line extended.
Get back in stance and slide 3 more steps.
Jog back to the baseline and go again.
